name: uv_close

ownership.argument: Marks a live libuv handle closing on its owning loop. Retains handle storage until close_callback(handle) is invoked from uv_run. Caller may free its containing allocation only in that callback.

provenance.source: Exact Q66 .155 IDB recovery recorded in EVID-ASTROLINK-4155-BLE-001; Astrolink static ABI audit on 2026-10-30.

notes: Exact private ABI recovery, not public approval. C3EA6FA marks CLOSING at handle+44; C3EA702 stores callback at +12. uv_run C3EADF6-C3EAE06 removes the handle queue and invokes callback(handle). Stock C736FE0 closes a 64-byte async allocation; callback C735A72 frees it at C735A76.
